common.accept.note: Button that accepts a friend request.

common.add.note: Button that adds what was typed in a form (for example a new user).

common.apply.note: Button that applies a change, such as trimming a video.

common.back.note: Button that returns to the previous step of a wizard or dialog.

common.cancel.note: Button that closes a dialog or stops an action without changing anything. Every app.

common.choose.note: Button in a folder picker that picks the folder being looked at.

common.close.note: Button or icon label that closes a panel, viewer or dialog.

common.connect.note: Button that connects to the device or to a Wi-Fi network.

common.connecting.note: Shown while connecting to the device or a Wi-Fi network.

common.create.note: Button that creates a new collection from the selected photos.

common.decline.note: Button that turns down a friend request.

common.delete.note: Button or menu item that deletes the selected photos, files, users or links, usually after a confirmation.

common.deleting.note: Shown on the Delete button while the deletion runs.

common.deselect.note: Accessibility action that takes one photo or file out of the selection.

common.disconnect.note: Button in the computer apps that disconnects from the device (after a confirmation).

common.done.note: Button that finishes a task or leaves an editing screen, keeping what was done.

common.download.note: Button that downloads a file or a ZIP to this computer or phone.

common.loading.note: Shown while a list or a picture is loading.

common.next.note: Button that goes to the next step of a wizard or dialog.

common.ok.note: Button that closes a message after reading it. Use the platform's usual word.

common.open.note: Button that opens a shared link or a folder.

common.password.note: Label of a password field (the device's password, an account's, or a Wi-Fi network's).

common.pause.note: Button that pauses uploads or the live log view.

common.quit.note: Menu item that quits the computer app.

common.refresh.note: Button that reloads a list (friends, files).

common.remove.note: Button that takes an item out of a list or a selection without deleting the file itself.

common.rename.note: Button or menu item that gives a person, collection or file a new name.

common.resume.note: Button that continues what Pause stopped.

common.save.note: Button that stores a change (a new name, a setting).

common.search.note: Button that runs a search, or the search field's short placeholder.

common.select.note: Button or accessibility action that starts selecting, or selects one photo or file.

common.send.note: Button that sends something: a friend request, the device's logs.

common.settings.note: The Settings section or screen, in menus and titles.

common.share.note: Button or menu item that shares photos or files (opens the share options).

common.try_again.note: Button shown after something failed, to repeat it.

common.update.note: Button on the update banner that opens the device's software update. A verb.

common.updating.note: Shown while the device installs a software update.

common.upload.note: Button that sends the selected items from this phone to the device.
